title: Emile's mouthpiece preferences
summary: Asked about the mouthpiece on the clarinet Russell got from him, Emile says he dislikes small mouthpieces and likes a bigger one.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Well, you know that clarinet I got from you that time, Millie? Uh-huh. That mouthpiece that was on there, was that the kind that you blew? I mean, that was the mouthpiece that you were using?
Well, that was kind of the same kind of a mouthpiece.

Yeah, yeah. Why, too? You see, I don't know. I believe I got a mouthpiece on that other clarinet. That I never used. Uh-huh. It's a little mouthpiece, you know? Uh-huh. And I don't like a little mouthpiece. I like a bigger mouthpiece.
Oh, this is a little bigger, isn't it? Uh-huh.
Oh, if it wouldn't, you'll find it out right away. Uh-huh. And I think the song's got a nice sound.
It's a nice tone, isn't it? Yeah. I kind of like the tone of it. Yeah. It's a beautiful tone. Uh-huh. Mm-hmm.
It's alright, it's a little bit dry. Oh yeah, it must be warm and warm. Nice finish.
